newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Technihire warns on profit fall, may delist.
newsitem.headline: Technihire warns on profit fall, may delist.

text.p: Technihire Ltd said on Friday that the potential losses from significant debtors, referred to in two earlier cautionaries, would have a material impact on the firm's profitabilty.

Technihire said that the potential losses, which appear to be due to fraudulent activity, would reduce capital and consequent loan funding required resulting in losses exceeding the net asset value of the firm.
The firm said that Adecco SA, its ultimate holding company, has issued a guarantee of 10 million rand to ensure the trading ability of the firm remins unimparied.
However, it would take time to restore the company to profitability and recapitalisation will be necessary.
As part of its global restructuring and as a result of the current situation, Adecco was in talks regarding a restructuring or possible delisting of the firm.
An offer to minorities of 50 cents a share was being considered. Operations within the Technihire group would be unaffected and any dividends payable to shareholders would be paid on due date.
Shareholders were advised to continue to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
